summary: This document adds an RSA-R mode to MIKEY for cases where the initiator doesn't know the responder's public key or identity ahead of time, as with call forwarding. It also lets group members start a key download themselves. It updates RFC 3830.

eli5.summary: Usually you need someone's lock before sending them a secret. This lets the receiver show their own lock first, so a call can be secured even if you reached the wrong person.
